h1: Duplex Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Bratislava, 158 m²

blocks.text: Duplex Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Bratislava, 158 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed and completed a comprehensive project for a 158 m² duplex apartment with a 20 m² terrace in Bratislava, Slovakia. The project combined interior design, technical documentation, custom-made furniture and comprehensive turnkey renovation.

The interior follows a distinctive TOTAL BLACK concept. Deep dark tones, clean architectural geometry, carefully selected textures and sophisticated lighting scenarios define the overall aesthetic, creating a contemporary interior with a strong individual character.

The layout includes the living room, bedrooms, kitchen with integrated appliances, walk-in wardrobes, entrance hall, bathrooms and functional storage systems. Particular attention was given to the ergonomics of the duplex layout and the visual connection between the different functional areas of the apartment.

Custom-made furniture was developed specifically for the project, including the kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving and storage systems. The furniture was designed together with the interior, allowing it to be precisely integrated into the architecture while maintaining a consistent design language throughout the apartment.

Before implementation, a detailed estimate was prepared covering construction and finishing works, materials, custom furniture, household appliances, sanitary equipment, lighting and other required elements. Following the design stage, the turnkey apartment renovation in Bratislava was completed according to the developed technical documentation.

This 158 m² duplex apartment demonstrates DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s comprehensive approach to residential interiors in Bratislava — from the initial concept and technical solutions to custom furniture and complete interior implementation.
